items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I have a reputation in the business as honest John, you know

ctx.x: You mentioned earlier that you had recorded someone in Mexico City and there was something significant about facilities there.
Oh yes. I did. Well, when I was with ABC, there was a young lady who came in, and she had $30,000

and she wanted somebody -- someone sent her to me and told her I better give her some direction because she's running around with this $30,000 check -- and I have a reputation in the business as honest John, you know, so I'll try to direct somebody in the right direction.
